description: This file contains the implementation of the WeightClass model for the Opencart admin localisation module. It defines methods to add, edit, delete, and retrieve weight class data from the database, including descriptions and related metadata.

classes.name: WeightClass
classes.description: Defines the model for managing weight classes, including CRUD operations and descriptions tailored to multiple languages within the Opencart admin localisation namespace.

methods.name: addWeightClass
methods.description: Inserts a new weight class into the database, including its descriptions across different languages, returning the inserted weight class ID.

methods.name: editWeightClass
methods.description: Updates an existing weight class's value and descriptions in the database, identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteWeightClass
methods.description: Deletes a weight class and its descriptions from the database using its ID.

methods.name: getWeightClasses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of weight classes with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getWeightClass
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific weight class by ID, including its description tailored to the current language.

methods.name: getTotalWeightClasses
methods.description: Returns the total count of weight classes in the database.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description entry for a weight class in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Removes all description entries associated with a specific weight class ID.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all description entries for a given language ID across weight classes.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions associated with a specific weight class ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Returns all weight class descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByUnit
methods.description: Fetches description details of weight classes filtered by their unit.
